translations.web: They broke down the pillar of Baal, and broke down the house of Baal, and made it a latrine, to this day.
translations.bsb: They also demolished the sacred pillar of Baal. Then they tore down the temple of Baal and made it into a latrine, which it is to this day.
translations.kjv: And they brake down the image of Baal, and brake down the house of Baal, and made it a draught house unto this day.
translations.asv: And they brake down the pillar of Baal, and brake down the house of Baal, and made it a draught-house, unto this day.
